street: Shellfish Drive (east branch, curve into Marina Dr)
evidence: Block near full-res (5265,2720), sitting in the 60' Shellfish corridor between the NE outer R/W curve (chords 51.68', 68.75', 59.50') and the SE/lower R/W curve (chord 121.56' N61°26'55"E). Lines: '℄ Curve Data' / 'R=167.95  T.=82.35' / 'Δ=52°17'10"'. No foot-mark after 167.95 or 82.35 in the ink. Re-read at 5x and 12x: R digits 1-6-7-.-9-5, T digits 8-2-.-3-5. The symbol before 'Curve Data' is the surveyor's centerline sign: a small 'C' with a vertical bar through/beside it (renders like '¢' / '℄'), i.e. CENTERLINE. Text line layout: '℄ Curve Data' / 'R=..'-T.=..'' / 'Δ=..°..'.."'.
ambiguities: !!! T DISAGREES WITH R AND Δ: R*tan(Δ/2) = 82.434 but printed T = 82.35 (residual 0.084 ft, >4x the 0.02 tolerance). Not silently fixed. Digit-by-digit: 'T.=82.3?' third digit is a flat-topped '3' (same glyph as the 3 in N.35°); last digit 5. R=167.95 is independently supported by FIVE printed chords (121.56 with R-30, 51.68/68.75/59.50 with R+30 - see edge items), so the suspect number is T (or R in T's own calc). T=82.35 would need R=167.778; T=82.43 would be the formula value. Whether this is a plat typo or a mis-set digit cannot be decided from the scan; keep T as printed.
